concept: EC2 purchasing: Compute Savings Plans — discount with family flexibility
tests: Choosing a pricing model for a steady 24/7 workload over 3 years with the flexibility to change instance family.
expected: 3-year Compute Savings Plans — RI-level discount with flexibility across family, size, Region, OS, plus Fargate and Lambda. Triggers: "steady 24/7", "three years", "flexibility to change instance family".
why_not: Standard RIs — deep discount but locked to instance attributes; On-Demand — the most expensive; Spot — interruptions, not for stable production.
